title: La Pedrera is not to be missed!
text: It’s one of Gaudí’s most iconic works. He was well at the cutting edge of the Modernist movement and imprinted his own beliefs and ideas in it. Not to be missed!

title: Amazing experience - ask for Carla!
text: This was such a beautiful visit. We had Carla as a tour guide and she was friendly and super knowledgeable. The other family on the tour did not show so we basically had a private tour. Carla told us all the history of the house and a few interesting anecdotes about Gaudi. She stopped to take family pictures for us and suggested other local visits. She made the tour super!!
